title: Shape operator: Dν(x) maps span T_xM into itself and is symmetric there (C² chart, Schwarz)
statement: Shape operator of a hypersurface in A₀. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; a linear subspace A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P; M, O ⊆ ℝ^P; ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P. Hypotheses: dim A₀ = m + 1; M ⊆ A₀; M is an embedded C² m-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 m M); O is open, M ⊆ O and ν is C¹ on O; for every x ∈ M, ν(x) ∈ A₀, |ν(x)| = 1 and ν(x)·v = 0 for every v ∈ tangentSpace M x. Conclusion: for every x ∈ M and every τ ∈ S_x := span(tangentSpace M x), Dν(x)τ ∈ S_x, and η·Dν(x)τ = τ·Dν(x)η for every η ∈ S_x, where Dν(x) = fderiv ℝ ν x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M O : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 m M → IsOpen O → M ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ν O → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → ∀ x ∈ M, ∀ τ ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x), fderiv ℝ ν x τ ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x) ∧ ∀ η ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x), inner ℝ η (fderiv ℝ ν x τ) = inner ℝ τ (fderiv ℝ ν x η)
